name: weekly-review-moderation-audit
description: Weekly seller review moderation audit — checks moderation queue health and DSA Art. 5 compliance.
prompt: Audit review moderation queue from last 7 days. Check auto-approve and auto-reject rates. Review human queue backlog (alert if > 50 pending). Check for any reviews that bypassed moderation. Verify DSA Art. 5 moderation log completeness. Generate weekly review health report.
